title: Calibration Workmanship Warranty: Amount of the Calibration Diagnostic Charge
content:
**Billing rule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the calibration diagnostic charge on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty concern is the plan's standard diagnostic fee, charged in full once for the concern, in US dollars rounded to the cent.

## Elements of the rule

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Amount | The plan's standard diagnostic fee, as the plan's rate card states it for the Calibration Workmanship Warranty |
| Extent | Charged in full |
| Frequency | Once for the concern |
| Currency and precision | US dollars, rounded to the cent |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Taking a hypothetical standard diagnostic fee of USD 75.00: the calibration diagnostic charge on the concern is USD 75.00, charged in full, once, and expressed to the cent as USD 75.00.

Q. Is a second calibration diagnostic charge posted for the same concern?
A. No. The charge is posted once for the concern.

Q. Is the charge ever stated in fractions of a cent?
A. No. It is stated in US dollars rounded to the cent.
